mainServices.subtitle: Physician-directed healthcare and supportive assistance, delivered with steady hands in the comfort of home.
mainServices.overviewText: Our comprehensive suite of in-home skilled clinical services, specialized medical programs, and personal support is designed to promote healing, independence, and comfort. Each service is tailored to meet the individual needs of patients and their families.

skilled-nursing.title: Skilled Nursing
skilled-nursing.subtitle: Professional clinical care delivered right to your doorstep.
skilled-nursing.overview: Our skilled nursing services provide comprehensive, physician-directed medical care administered by licensed Registered Nurses (RNs) and Licensed Practical Nurses (LPNs). We focus on managing complex health conditions, preventing hospital readmissions, and empowering patients through education.

physical-therapy.title: Physical Therapy
physical-therapy.subtitle: Restoring strength, balance, and independence.
physical-therapy.overview: Our licensed physical therapists work closely with your physician to design customized in-home rehabilitation programs aimed at restoring functional mobility, alleviating pain, and reducing the risk of future injuries.
topics: Rehabilitation after illness, injury, or surgery

occupational-therapy.title: Occupational Therapy
occupational-therapy.subtitle: Enhancing daily living skills and personal independence.
occupational-therapy.overview: Occupational therapy helps patients adapt to physical changes, regain vital fine-motor skills, and safely navigate daily routines and household environments with confidence.

speech-therapy.title: Speech Therapy
speech-therapy.subtitle: Improving communication and swallowing safety.
speech-therapy.overview: Our speech-language pathologists provide specialized evaluation and therapeutic interventions for individuals experiencing speech, language, cognitive-communication, or swallowing disorders.

medical-social-services.title: Medical Social Services
medical-social-services.subtitle: Navigating social, emotional, and resource challenges.
medical-social-services.overview: Medical social workers help patients and families cope with the social, emotional, and financial challenges associated with acute or chronic health conditions by connecting them with vital community resources.

home-health-aide.title: Home Health Aide Services
home-health-aide.subtitle: Compassionate assistance with personal care and daily hygiene.
home-health-aide.overview: Certified home health aides provide reliable, respectful, and dignified hands-on personal care support under the direct supervision of our clinical care team.
topics: Assistance with activities of daily living
Support provided under the supervision of the clinical care team

wound-care.title: Wound Care
wound-care.subtitle: Specialized clinical management for optimal tissue healing.
wound-care.overview: Our expert clinical team provides advanced wound management protocols designed to accelerate healing, prevent complications, and mitigate the risk of infection.

chronic-disease-management.title: Chronic Disease Management
chronic-disease-management.subtitle: Proactive oversight and management for long-term health conditions.
chronic-disease-management.overview: We empower patients living with ongoing health conditions to maintain stability, manage symptoms effectively, and avoid unnecessary hospital visits through structured in-home care.

medication-management.title: Medication Management
medication-management.subtitle: Ensuring safety, adherence, and clarity with your prescriptions.
medication-management.overview: Our clinical team reviews, reconciles, and educates patients on their medication regimens to prevent adverse interactions and ensure proper administration.

post-surgical-care.title: Post-Surgical Care
post-surgical-care.subtitle: Seamless transition from hospital to home.
post-surgical-care.overview: We provide comprehensive post-operative monitoring and supportive care to ensure a smooth recovery and reduce recovery complications in familiar surroundings.

fall-prevention.title: Fall Prevention and Home Safety
fall-prevention.subtitle: Creating secure environments and steady mobility.
fall-prevention.overview: We assess environmental hazards and physical factors to implement targeted balance, strength, and safety protocols that protect against accidental falls.

companion-care.title: Companion Care
companion-care.subtitle: Friendly social engagement and daily reassurance.
companion-care.overview: Companion care offers meaningful human connection, safety oversight, and supportive help with light routine activities to enhance overall day-to-day well-being.

respite-care.title: Respite Care
respite-care.subtitle: Dedicated temporary relief for family caregivers.
respite-care.overview: Our respite care program provides reliable, short-term in-home support, giving primary family caregivers essential time to rest, recharge, and attend to personal needs.

daily-lifestyle-support.title: Daily Lifestyle Support
daily-lifestyle-support.subtitle: Practical assistance for everyday comfort and ease.
daily-lifestyle-support.overview: We help patients manage routine household tasks and personal organization to foster maximum independence and enhance quality of life at home.

veteran-care.title: Veteran Care
veteran-care.subtitle: Honoring those who served with specialized in-home care.
veteran-care.overview: We proudly coordinate and deliver authorized clinical and supportive home health solutions tailored to the unique healthcare needs of veterans and eligible family members.
topics: Support for veterans and eligible family members
veteran-care.disclaimer: Eligibility and authorization are determined by the Department of Veterans Affairs and the applicable VA Community Care process.

adults-with-disabilities.title: Services for Adults with Disabilities
adults-with-disabilities.subtitle: Empowering autonomy, dignity, and specialized daily support.
adults-with-disabilities.overview: Our specialized care programs for adults with disabilities focus on maximizing personal independence, maintaining health stability, and ensuring a safe, dignified lifestyle at home.
topics: Dignity, safety, and quality of life

pediatric-services.title: Pediatric Services — Coming Soon
pediatric-services.subtitle: Expanding our continuum of care to support children and families.
pediatric-services.recommendedCopy: One Community Home Health is preparing to expand its services to support children and their families. Pediatric services are not currently available. Join our email list to receive updates as program information becomes available.
